what_this_is: The identity and recency facts that govern every read of v_agent_earned_observations. Dated measurements, not assertions — re-run the SQL before relying on them.

identity_spaces.repid_agents.id: uuid — the key the observation view is keyed on
identity_spaces.repid_agents.agent_id: text — a DIFFERENT identifier, uuid-shaped on 0 of 176 rows
identity_spaces.sql: select (select count(*) from repid_agents a where exists (select 1 from v_agent_earned_observations o where o.agent_id = a.id)) as on_id, (select count(*) from repid_agents a where exists (select 1 from v_agent_earned_observations o where o.agent_id::text = a.agent_id)) as on_agent_id, (select count(*) from repid_agents where agent_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-') as uuid_shaped;
identity_spaces.why_it_matters: The two spaces are DISJOINT, so the wrong key returns an empty set rather than raising. Every agent then reads as never-observed, and a scoring or decay rule built on that reads as 'no track record' when the track record is 152,473 rows. NOT claimed: that this caused any published figure — reading by the text column zeroes EVERY agent uniformly, which does not fit the one retraction of 2026-08-17.

recency_source.sql: select count(*) as total, count(last_active_at) as written, count(*) filter (where last_active_at >= now() - interval '30 days') as recent from repid_agents; select count(distinct agent_id) from v_agent_earned_observations where observed_at >= now() - interval '30 days';
recency_source.why_it_matters: repid_agents.last_active_at reports 17 recently-active agents where the observation evidence shows 67, and it is NULL on 11 of the 12 ratcheted rows. It is a side effect of one betting-resolution function, not an activity signal. A decay or dormancy rule keyed on it expires standing for agents that are demonstrably active.

ratchet_census.sql: with pinned as (select a.id, a.is_human, a.lifecycle_status from repid_agents a where a.current_repid = tier_lower_bound(a.peak_repid)), obs as (select agent_id, count(*) n, max(observed_at) last_obs from v_agent_earned_observations group by 1) select count(*) filter (where coalesce(o.n,0)=0) as zero_obs, count(*) filter (where o.last_obs >= now() - interval '30 days') as recent from pinned p left join obs o on o.agent_id = p.id;
ratchet_census.supersedes: The figure '6 floor-holders have never been observed at all' is RETRACTED: no window reproduces it (3 ever / 4 in 30d / 3 in 120d). Its CAUSE is UNVERIFIED — the originating query was not preserved. All 3 genuinely unobserved floor-holders are lifecycle_status='test_only', so no real agent holds a floor with zero evidence and the never-earned base case reached fixture rows only.
ratchet_census.note_on_trinity_gcm: 33,434 observations all-time but only 15 in the trailing 30 days, and it is being observed live (+2 in ~20 minutes during this measurement). A previously published '12 observations in 30 days' is CONSISTENT with this and is NOT retracted — quoting the all-time count against a 30-day claim would be the same units error as the hyperdag byte/character retraction.
